📖 1. Registration Overview: Individual vs. Bulk

Mode Who It Is For How It Works
Individual Single devotee self-registering for a camp retreat Log in at voicegurukul.com → Go to Camps → Select Dates, Meals & Stay → Pay online → Instant QR Pass.
Bulk / Center Center Managers, Voice Managers, Project Managers, OCs Add multiple devotees via Center Dropdown or Manual Entry → Single payment / IDT → Passes emailed to all participants.

👤 2. Flow A: Individual Devotee Registration (Step-by-Step)

Step 1 Visit Portal & Sign In / Register Account
Go to https://voicegurukul.com/. If you are already registered, enter your Email and Password to log in. If new, click Sign Up to create your profile with your Legal Name, WhatsApp Number, Daily Chanting Rounds, and Center/Temple affiliation.
📷 Screen 1: Official VOICE Gurukul Login & Registration Portal
Step 2 Navigate to Camps & Choose Camp
In your dashboard, click on Camps or visit /dashboard/camp. You will see all active camps (e.g. Sankalpa, Sphurti, Prerna, Nistha). Click "Register Now" on the camp you wish to attend.
📷 Screen 2: Active Camps Dashboard & Selection Cards

👤 2. Flow A: Individual Registration (Continued)

Step 3 Select Sub-Camp Track (Role & Chanting Rounds Protected)
Select your desired sub-camp track (e.g. Nistha Camp, GS Camp, etc.).
Automatic Role & Rounds Validation: Sub-camps restricted to specific roles (e.g. Director only) or minimum daily chanting rounds (e.g. 16 rounds minimum) will only be visible if your profile qualifies.
📷 Screen 3: Selecting Sub-Camp Track & Participant Details
Step 4 Configure Meals, Arrival/Departure Dates & CV Accommodation
Fill in your itinerary. The live dynamic fee calculator breaks down Meals, Stay, and Booklet charges in real-time.
  • Arrival / Departure: Select your arrival date & meal slot (Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner) and departure meal slot.
  • Accommodation from CV: Choose "Yes, need CV accommodation" (if available) or "No, do not need / arrange own stay".
  • Live Pricing Breakdown: Transparent itemized total (e.g. Meals ₹900 + Stay ₹750 + Juices ₹200 = Total ₹1,850).
📷 Screen 4: Meals & Stay Itinerary, CV Accommodation Choice & Live Cost Breakdown
Step 5 Complete Payment & Get Instant Digital QR Pass
Pay securely online via UPI, Credit/Debit Card, or NetBanking (Razorpay). Upon successful payment, your Official Digital Camp Entry Pass with Barcode / QR Code is generated immediately under My Passes.
📷 Screen 5: Digital QR Camp Entry Pass with Room & Meal Details (Shown under 'My Passes')

👥 3. Flow B: Bulk / Center Manager Registration

How to Become a Center Manager / Activate Center
• Centers previously registered via the circulated Google Form already have their Center/Project Manager accounts created.
• If you are not yet a manager: First register as a normal user on voicegurukul.com, then personally contact HG Sri Murali Vadan Das (+91 7387876169). He will set up your center and assign you as Center Manager / BC Voice Manager.

Two Options for Adding Center Devotees:

Option 1 Pick from Center Devotees Dropdown (Recommended)
Devotees in your center must first create a free account on voicegurukul.com. Once registered, simply search and select their name from the "Select from Center Devotees" dropdown.
  • Instant Auto-fill: Participant Name, WhatsApp, Email, Chanting Rounds & Roles auto-populate automatically.
  • Zero Typo Risk: Eliminates wrong email addresses and prevents duplicate entries.
📷 Screen 6: Selecting Devotee from Center Devotees Dropdown with Auto-filled Profile
Option 2 Manual Devotee Entry (For Unregistered Participants)
If a devotee has not yet created an account, choose "Manual Entry" and fill in their Full Name, WhatsApp, Email, Gender, Age, Chanting Rounds, and Counselor.
📷 Screen 7: Manual Devotee Entry Form for Center In-Charge
CRITICAL WARNING — Enter Exact Participant Email ID!
The Manager / OC MUST enter the participant's correct, personal email address. The devotee's QR Camp Entry Pass, check-in instructions, camp booklet, and schedule updates will be emailed directly to that address. If a fake or manager-only email is entered, the participant will NOT receive their pass.

🏨 4. Accommodation Policies & Evaluation (CV vs. Outside & BC)

Type Capacity & Allocation Pass Issuance & Verification Flow
CV Accommodation Strictly limited capacity — First-Come, First-Served. Instant Pass: Confirmed immediately upon payment with bed/room allotment details. Devotees must carry this pass.
Outside Hotel / Lodge Compulsory when CV accommodation is full, or by choice. Waiting List & Review: Devotee/manager must upload hotel booking receipt. Central team evaluates receipt and approves pass.
Brahmachari (BC) Dedicated for full-time monk devotees. Free Stay & Meals: Prasadam and accommodation are completely FREE with minimal token registration fee. Registration mandatory.
Outside Stay Outside Hotel Booking Confirmation Receipt Upload
When CV accommodation is filled, select "Outside Accommodation". You will be prompted to upload the hotel booking receipt or voucher. Your pass will be set to Waiting List until evaluated by the central camp committee.
📷 Screen 8: Uploading Hotel Booking Receipt for Outside Accommodation Verification

👑 5. Royal Camp Registration & Role Assignment Workflow

Exclusive Leadership Camp — Access Restriction
The Royal Camp is an exclusive leadership retreat track that is completely hidden from the camp dropdown for regular users. Only devotees who hold a recognized leadership role or Royal Member status can see and register for this camp.

Complete List of Qualifying Royal Camp Roles:

OC (Organizing Committee) Care Giver Youth Preacher Internal Manager Preaching Coordinator Director Managing Director Acting Manager Project Manager Central VOICE Manager Project Advisor Voice Manager / BC Voice Manager Royal Member (Special Status) Super Admin, President, Vice-President
Step-by-Step How to Assign Royal Status in Project Manager Section
  1. Devotee Registers on Website First: Devotee creates a basic user account on voicegurukul.com.
  2. Manager Opens Project Manager Section: Go to Project Manager → Total Devotees (If section not visible, call HG Sri Murali Vadan Das at +91 7387876169).
  3. Assign Role / Royal Member: Locate devotee, click Edit Profile, assign any qualifying role above (e.g. Director, OC, Youth Preacher, Internal Manager, Care Giver) or toggle Royal Member: YES, and save.
  4. Register for Camp: Open Camps → Register, select that devotee → Royal Camp will now appear in the dropdown!
📷 Screen 9: Assigning Roles / Royal Member Status in Project Manager → Total Devotees Section
Pass Cancellation & Refund Rules:
Devotees can request cancellation anytime from My Passes. Tiered refund percentages apply automatically per cutoff rules.
